provenance.descriptions: reference/description-conventions.md (11 issued workbooks, 31 bill sheets, 3,605 priced items) + reference/POMI-COMPLETE-PROCESS.md per-section 'How this section is BILLED' tables
provenance.markup_hue: reference/determinism.md 4.10 MARKUP COLOUR [class D - K46] - declared closed and constant
provenance.markup_primitive: reference/POMI-COMPLETE-PROCESS.md per-section 'How this section is MARKED UP' tables
provenance.conflict: POMI-COMPLETE-PROCESS.md names a trade colour per section in words; determinism.md 4.10 gives a hex per section. They disagree for B, C, E, G, H, K, L, N and Q. determinism.md governs: it is hex-exact and declares the table closed. Recorded in DECISIONS.md as decision 8.

family_1.text: complete in accordance with the Specifications and Drawings
family_1.variant: complete in accordance with the Specifications, Drawings and the {approving_party} approval

family_2.text: in accordance with the {design_standard}, Specifications and Drawings
family_2.note: {design_standard} is named from the project's own documents. Never carried across from another job. Absent from the project documents it is a gap, not a default.

family_3.text: Supply and install all {system} as shown on the drawings and/or as specified including but not limited to {deemed_included} and any other items required for a complete installation as indicated.
family_3.note: {deemed_included} is written from the POMI deemed-included list for the clause being billed (reference/pomi-verbatim.md), never from memory. The issued Electrical bills close eight descriptions 'a indicated' for 'as indicated' - a typo. Do not reproduce it.

none.note: these sections bill items, sums or particulars, not measured work

descriptions.note: POMI H1.1 / H2.1: enumerated, stating size and type. The house bills write the unit, its size, then its type: 'Single leaf, swing type, hollow metal door, size 1100mm x 2200mm, type S1.2'.

description_layout.block_carries: no item reference, no quantity, no rate
description_layout.variant_rows: each variant on its own row, one blank row between
description_layout.optional_subheading: a single line may sit between the block and the variants
description_layout.note: the whole group never splits across a page. A run of sized variants with no description block above it is a gate failure.

markup.primitive_rule: LISTED, not spotted - legend entry with no dot
markup.tag: listed in the sheet legend only

markup.primitive_rule: AREA for excavation, fill and paving; LINEAR for trenches, kerbs and fencing; TAG for trial holes, boreholes, trees, piles and drainage accessories
AREA for slabs, beds and walls in elevation; TAG for columns and isolated bases
markup.tag: C-{serial}  {qty} m3 - the label states the thickness

markup.primitive_rule: AREA - walls marked in ELEVATION, not in plan
LINEAR along each member; TAG for trusses, portal frames and isolated units
markup.tag: E-{serial}  {qty} kg - with the unit weight in the label, per GP5.4

markup.primitive_rule: LINEAR for structural timbers; AREA for open-spaced boarding and battens
markup.tag: F-{serial}  {qty} m - cross-section stated, per GP5.2

markup.primitive_rule: AREA - sloping areas marked on the roof plan but labelled ON SLOPE
markup.tag: G-{serial}  {qty} m2 - a sloping area carries both the plan area and the pitch

markup.primitive_rule: TAG - every item in the section is enumerated
markup.tag: H-{serial}  {n} nr, with the type reference

markup.primitive_rule: AREA for finishes; LINEAR for skirtings, coves and dividing strips
markup.tag: J-{serial}  {qty} m2 - a suspended ceiling carries the DROP, per J5.1

markup.primitive_rule: LINEAR for partitions, rails and trims; TAG for enumerated accessories

markup.tag: L-{serial}  {n} nr, with the type reference
M-{serial}  {n} nr, with the type reference

markup.primitive_rule: mixed - follows whichever section the work is measured to
markup.tag: N-{serial} on the special item; ordinary work carries its own section's code

markup.primitive_rule: TAG for the units; LISTED for the five P2.1 sundry items
markup.tag: P-{serial}  {n} nr, with capacity and stops

markup.primitive_rule: LINEAR for pipe and duct runs; TAG for plant and terminals; AREA for insulation and rectangular duct where measured by area
markup.tag: Q-{serial}  {qty} m with the size, or {n} nr

markup.primitive_rule: LINEAR for cable, conduit and trunking runs; TAG for points, boards and equipment
markup.tag: R-{serial}  {qty} m with the size, or {n} nr with the point class

markup_shade_ladder.basis: the item's ordinal position within the SHEET, in bill order
markup_shade_ladder.on_seventh: SPLIT SHEET - never a reused colour. Two items sharing a colour on one sheet is BS11.

markup_downgrades.note: a shaded polygon over a raster is a polygon the seat invented
